description: Deliberately failing scenario: the reply contradicts the claim and the test insists the claim holds, so every run fails semantically and the verdict report is produced. The call carries one per-call fact so the report shows a Facts line. Run counts come from this project's testDefaults; the excerpt bound from its excerptChars.
name: insists on a claim the reply contradicts
response: The traffic light at the corner of King Street turned red, and every car came to a stop.
claim: The reply says the traffic light turned green.
fact: King Street has one traffic light.
